description: Authorizes a read of one GitHub pull request, owner/repo#number, through the GitHub connector (github:pr-fetch). Reads never change anything. Every read needs a signed human approval for that exact pull request. The target must name a pull request, and anything else is refused.

outcome.reason: Refused: no signed approval covers reading this pull request.
Read approved: a signed approval covers this pull request.
Refused: the target is not a pull request reference.
